findings.title: OpenAPI documentation publicly accessible when DOCS_API_KEY is unset in production
findings.observation: In production, verify_docs_access skips authentication entirely when DOCS_API_KEY environment variable is empty, leaving /docs, /redoc, and /openapi.json open.
findings.risk: Attackers can enumerate the full API surface, accelerating targeted exploitation.
findings.recommendation: Fail closed in production when DOCS_API_KEY is unset, or disable doc routes entirely. Set a strong DOCS_API_KEY in all prod/staging environments immediately.

findings.title: /metrics endpoint publicly readable when METRICS_API_KEY is unset

evidence.excerpt: The registry carries tenant_id-labeled series ... production MUST set it because /metrics is tenant-exempt

findings.observation: Metrics exposition allows unauthenticated access when METRICS_API_KEY is empty. Endpoint is listed in PUBLIC_ENDPOINTS bypassing tenant middleware.
findings.risk: Leakage of per-tenant operational metrics and infrastructure reconnaissance.
findings.recommendation: Require METRICS_API_KEY in production; restrict /metrics at ingress to scraper IPs; never deploy with empty key.

findings.title: WebSocket authentication accepts JWT via query string parameter

evidence.excerpt:
tenant_id: Optional[int] = Query(default=None),
token: Optional[str] = Query(default=None),
Do NOT add a query-string token parameter — tokens in URLs leak via server logs, Referer headers, and browser history.

findings.observation: SSE endpoint documentation warns against query-string tokens, but the WebSocket endpoint still accepts token as a query parameter.
findings.risk: JWT leakage via access logs, Referer headers, and browser history enables session hijacking.
findings.recommendation: Authenticate WebSocket via Sec-WebSocket-Protocol bearer token or post-connect auth message; remove query param token.

findings.title: Development docker-compose defaults USE_MOCK_AD_DATA to true
findings.observation: Default dev compose enables mock ad platform data. Production validator rejects mock data only when APP_ENV is production/staging.
findings.risk: Mis-deployed stack with wrong APP_ENV or wrong compose file could serve fabricated metrics to paying customers.
findings.recommendation: Always deploy with docker-compose.prod.yml; add deploy checklist; consider default false even in dev compose.
assumptions: ASSUMPTION: Operators might accidentally use docker-compose.yml instead of prod overlay — confidence MEDIUM

findings.title: Node.js version mismatch between CI (24) and frontend Dockerfile (26)

evidence.excerpt: Node 26 is too new. Measured on this workflow: the suite starts, then every storage-backed test fails...

findings.observation: CI tests on Node 24; production Docker image builds with Node 26. CI comments document vitest/jsdom storage regression on Node 26.
findings.risk: Production build/runtime behavior may diverge from tested behavior; latent frontend bugs in Node 26-only code paths.
findings.recommendation: Align Dockerfile to Node 24 until Node 26 storage issue is fixed, or fix CI to Node 26 with passing tests.

findings.title: E2E Playwright tests excluded from release gate

evidence.excerpt: needs: [backend-quality, backend-tests, backend-security, frontend, security, secrets, deploy-config]

findings.observation: e2e job exists and runs on PR/push but is not listed in the release gate needs array.
findings.risk: Merged code can break critical user flows (auth, onboarding, dashboard) without blocking release.
findings.recommendation: Add e2e to release gate needs once flake rate is acceptable.

findings.title: Ukrainian translation file exists but is not registered in i18n
findings.observation: uk/translation.json is present but not imported or added to i18n resources.
findings.risk: Incomplete localization for Ukrainian users; stale translation file may drift from en source.
findings.recommendation: Import uk translations in i18n.ts or remove unused locale file.

findings.title: i18next configured with escapeValue false
findings.observation: i18next will not HTML-escape interpolated values.
findings.risk: Stored XSS if user-controlled strings are passed to translation interpolation.
findings.recommendation: Audit all t() calls with dynamic values; enable escapeValue or sanitize inputs.
assumptions: ASSUMPTION: Most t() keys use static strings only — confidence MEDIUM

findings.title: Stripe webhook idempotency fails open when Redis is unavailable

evidence.excerpt:
# Deliberately fail open. The handlers re-fetch state from Stripe and
# are idempotent, so a duplicate is close to harmless; refusing the
# event instead would leave subscription state stale...

findings.observation: When Redis SET NX fails, webhook processing continues without duplicate guard.
findings.risk: Duplicate subscription state transitions or duplicate emails during Redis outage.
findings.recommendation: Document accepted risk or fail closed with 503 to trigger Stripe retry when Redis unavailable.

findings.title: Conflicting environment example templates
findings.observation: Root .env.example and backend/.env.example disagree on defaults and variable coverage.
findings.risk: Operator confusion leading to misconfiguration at deploy time.
findings.recommendation: Consolidate to single documented template aligned with config.py defaults.

findings.title: Tenant ID persisted in localStorage
findings.observation: Access tokens correctly use sessionStorage but tenant_id uses localStorage.
findings.risk: XSS could exfiltrate tenant context; cross-tab tenant confusion on shared machines.
findings.recommendation: Move tenant_id to sessionStorage or memory-only; validate server-side regardless.

findings.title: Default asset storage is local filesystem without durable volume in base compose

evidence.excerpt:
asset_storage_backend: str = Field(default="local")
asset_upload_dir: str = Field(default="uploads/assets")

findings.observation: Uploaded assets default to local path; dev compose bind-mounts source over container.
findings.risk: Creative asset loss on container restart/redeploy in production if S3 not configured.
findings.recommendation: Set asset_storage_backend=s3 and configure bucket for production.

findings.title: Competitor intelligence feature uses fabricated data when enabled

evidence.excerpt:
the competitor refresh worker fabricates benchmarks with random.randint
...
feature_competitor_intel: bool = Field(default=False)

findings.observation: Feature flag defaults off with explicit comment that enabled worker uses random data.
findings.risk: If flag accidentally enabled in prod, customers receive false competitive benchmarks.
findings.recommendation: Keep flag false for launch; add runtime warning if enabled without real provider.

findings.title: Campaign publish workflow disabled — no live platform integration
findings.observation: Publish endpoint returns 503 when flag false; drafts available without platform sync.
findings.risk: Product expectation mismatch if marketing promises live campaign publishing at launch.
findings.recommendation: Confirm launch scope excludes publish; keep flag false until adapter implemented.
assumptions: ASSUMPTION: Draft-only campaign builder is acceptable for v1 — confidence MEDIUM

findings.title: Application entrypoint main.py excluded from coverage measurement
findings.observation: main.py omitted from coverage report omit list.
findings.risk: Regressions in middleware ordering, health checks, or metrics gating may go unnoticed.
findings.recommendation: Add targeted integration tests for main.py routes; consider removing omit.
